summary: On Instagram, Nora is told the real length limit of a public reply with each tag, instead of a different number in her standing instructions.
details: Each Instagram tag now says that a reply over 320 characters is not posted. Her instructions used to say 300 while replies were refused only over 320.
Her instructions for public replies keep "about two sentences" and no longer name a number.
limitations: Not measured: there is no evaluation for Instagram replies, and too few have run to see whether her reply length changes.
